# Vendored evaluation code

The `lm_eval/tasks/ifeval` files are unmodified copies from EleutherAI's
lm-evaluation-harness at commit b954108c9baaaa934b4ad842033b31a97ee30816.
See ../vendor_sources.json for original URLs and checksums and HARNESS_LICENSE.md
for the project license. Individual files retain their copyright and Apache-2.0
license notices from Google Research where present. Empty package initializers
were added solely to permit local imports without installing the full harness.

No training code or external model is vendored here.
